data.long_meaning: In Greek, Halli is derived from the word 'halos,' meaning 'salt.' In a symbolic sense, this name represents the idea of God being our fortress or mountain of refuge. The name Halli appears in various forms throughout Greek and Christian traditions, often associated with the strength and protection of God. The name Halli carries the meaning “God is my mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Halli usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Halli total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_greek.name: Χάλι
